looks.text: Стилисты бренда Luisa Spagnoli предлагают интегрировать брюки Onega в элегантные многослойные образы, сочетая их с укороченной верхней одеждой и фактурным трикотажем: Вариант 1204: Вариант 1204: На витринах (Vetrina 90, Bambola 1): статусный городской ансамбль под укороченным пальто Soncio 0963 1161 в сочетании с жакетом Merende 2234 и рубашкой Leonidas 3173. Образ дополнен сумкой Idoneo 0928 0945 0007.

Вариант 1204: На витринах (Vetrina 91, Bambola 2): зимняя стилизация под пальто Soncio 0963 1161 с жакетом Mity 3441 и пуловером Contagiri 0202. Финальные акценты --- шляпа Renno 0930 и сумка Idoneo 0928 0945 0007.![](media/image127.jpg){width='0.5833333333333334in' height='0.78125in'}![](media/image128.jpg){width='0.5833333333333334in' height='0.78125in'}

en.a: Objection: "The tapestry motif feels too bold." Response: Explain that floral jacquard is a hallmark of elevated style. Suggest balancing it with an understated base piece, such as the Manos 0970 pullover, as styled in our displays. | Objection: "The tapestry fabric might be stiff." Response: The density of the fabric in the Sancire model is essential to maintaining the architectural shape and crisp lines of the cut. It guarantees the piece will retain a flawless appearance for years to come. | Objection: "The double-breasted cut visually widens the figure." Response: On the contrary, thanks to the vita sfilata construction (accentuated waist), this jacket 'gathers in' the silhouette, turning the fabric's structure into a figure-flattering tool. | Objection: "It's difficult to find trousers to match this texture." Response: Demonstrate the ready-made solution from Display Case 22: the Orlato 2436 trousers in warm tones create a harmonious transition and underscore the richness of the floral palette. | Objection: "This piece is only suited to formal occasions." Response: Thanks to the Regular fit, the jacket can be worn more casually. Suggest trying it with understated trousers for daytime meetings, adding an element of high fashion to everyday looks.
